WHERE dept_id IS NOT NULL AND dept_id <> 1

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE bonus IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY bonus DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE manager_id <> 3

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE bonus IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY bonus ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT e.id
FROM employees e
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM employees r
  WHERE r.manager_id = e.id
)

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL
  AND manager_id <> 3

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE dept_id IS DISTINCT FROM 3

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE manager_id IS DISTINCT FROM 2

SELECT e.id
FROM employees e
WHERE e.dept_id <> 1

SELECT id
FROM employees
WHERE bonus IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY bonus ASC, id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT id
FROM employees
ORDER BY bonus ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC
LIMIT 3
